mandate: C440 — test the price-only TRUNCATED PATH SIGNATURE (Chen iterated integrals / rough-path signature method) stat-arb family on 10 USDT-M linear perps at native 5m (2592 pre-registered configs). Per-bar primitives: perp_close real 5m kline close; log_return=log(c[t]/c[t-1]) (r[0]=0); abs_ret=|log_return|; sign=sign(log_return) (+1/-1/0, sign[0]=0); m[t]=mean_i r_i[t] (equal-weight market return). Causal trailing mean mu[t] and std sigma[t] of {r[t-W_q+1..t]}, W_q=256 (fallback 128). Standardized return z[t]=(r[t]-mu[t])/sigma[t] (z[t]=0 if sigma[t]<=0 or non-finite). Build the 2D path X_k=(tau_k, z_k), tau_k=k/(W-1) in [0,1], increments dX_k=X_k-X_{k-1}, and the exact piecewise-linear level-2 iterated integrals S^{ij}=sum_k[X^i_{k-1}*dX^j_k+0.5*dX^i_k*dX^j_k], i,j in {tau,z}. sig_area=0.5*(S12-S21) (Levy area), sig_norm=sqrt(S11^2+S12^2+S21^2+S22^2), sig_asym=|S12-S21|/(|S12|+|S21|+eps), sig_eent=Shannon entropy (nats) of p_ij=S^{ij}^2/sum S^{kl}^2. NaN if t<W_q, any NaN/non-finite in window, sigma[t]<=0, or zero energy. Seasonal baseline = trailing mean/std at same (weekday,tod) bucket from history strictly before bar t (causal shift(1)), NaN-aware, excluding NaN obs. Signals: 8 real+placebo (sig_area_dev, sig_norm_dev, sig_asym_dev, sig_eent_dev) + 4 placebos (i.i.d. permutation seed 20261440 of the standardized returns, same marginal, destroyed serial/dependence geometry). Single-leg dollar-neutral perp PnL with costs on turnover (taker=fee+slip; maker_blend=0.5*fee+slip). Gates: Holm+BH at alpha=0.05 (BOTH), MDE, stability, signal-vs-placebo attribution. PRE-REGISTERED NaN policy: metric NaN unless sufficient finite obs; seasonal stats NaN-aware min_periods excluding NaN obs; NaN-score bars weight 0.

data_quality.note: metric NaN share dominated by finite-obs requirements (t<W_q or sigma[t]<=0 or NaN in trailing window or zero level-2 energy).

methodology.raw_features: perp_close real 5m kline close from C312 (strictly positive, gap-free); log_return=log(c[t]/c[t-1]) (r[0]=0); abs_ret=|log_return|; sign=sign(log_return) (+1/-1/0, sign[0]=0).
methodology.primitives: causal trailing mean/std mu[t], sigma[t] of {r[t-W_q+1..t]}, W_q=256 (fallback 128); standardized return z[t]=(r[t]-mu[t])/sigma[t]; 2D path X_k=(tau_k, z_k), tau_k=k/(W-1); level-2 iterated integrals S^{ij}=sum_k[X^i_{k-1}*dX^j_k+0.5*dX^i_k*dX^j_k], i,j in {tau,z}; sig_area=0.5*(S12-S21); sig_norm=sqrt(sum S^2); sig_asym=|S12-S21|/(|S12|+|S21|+eps); sig_eent=Shannon entropy of p_ij=S^2/sum S^2.
methodology.signals: sig_area_dev/sig_norm_dev/sig_asym_dev/sig_eent_dev plus i.i.d.-permutation-surrogate placebos over W_q=256 (seed 20261440); score=-(v-m)/sd with m/sd trailing same-bucket mean/std (min_periods=3, excluding NaN, causal shift(1)); cross-sectional rank, dollar-neutral gross 1.0; NaN-score assets weight 0.
methodology.pnl: single-leg perp: pnl = sum_i pos_i * perp_ret_i.
methodology.costs: charged on turnover; taker = fee+slip; maker_blend = 0.5*fee+slip.
methodology.missing_data: non-finite -> NaN; never impute/ffill; insufficient valid obs -> NaN -> not traded (fail-closed).
methodology.multiple_testing: one-sided paired t-test of per-split OOS net vs 0; Holm step-down AND Benjamini-Hochberg over all 2592 configs at alpha=0.05.
methodology.attribution: mean |OOS net| per signal across all its configs; shares=|mean|/sum(|means|) over all 8 signals incl. placebos; dominant must be a real (non-placebo) signal with share >= 0.5 for attribution_ok.
methodology.stability: sign consistency >= 0.70 of splits AND first/second-half Sharpe corr >= 0.5.
methodology.placebo: i.i.d. permutation (seed 20261440) of the standardized returns z before the path-signature pipeline; same marginal distribution, destroyed serial/dependence geometry; deterministic seed recorded; never market data, never fabricated.
methodology.signature_vectorization_note: per-asset level-2 iterated integrals via closed-form sliding-window accumulation O(T*W); chunked over windows to bound memory; validated against a naive explicit double-loop reference with maxdiff < 1e-12 in tests.
